observations: Black sewing machine head with gold scrollwork, branded "TWO LION" visible clearly in photo 2 on the machine arm and again on the bed plate in photo 1.
Machine head is mounted/sitting inside an orange-red wooden cabinet/table in all three photos.
No motor or electrical cord visible; appears to be a manual (hand-crank or treadle-style) head.
Thread is strung through the machine, bobbin area visible but no stitched fabric sample shown.
Seller's text is cut off after "Comes with...", so the included-accessories list is incomplete.
Watermark "HARDEX HARTARNDA" and "POSTED ON JIJI" overlay the images, consistent with a reposted listing photo set.

claims.evidence: Only cosmetic exterior is visible in photos; internal wear and mechanical condition cannot be judged from stills.

claims.claim: Two Lion black head sewing machine
claims.evidence: Brand name 'TWO LION' clearly legible on the machine plate in photo 2 and photo 1.
All three photos show the head sitting inside/on a wooden orange cabinet, so it's unclear whether the cabinet is included or just a prop; no separate shot of the head alone.
Seller's description is truncated; no photo shows accessories such as bobbins, extra needles, or belt.

risks.risk: Mechanical function unknown — whether the hand-crank/treadle mechanism turns smoothly, stitches evenly, tension is correct.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine being hand-cranked and stitching a scrap of fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needs servicing

risks.risk: Unclear whether the wooden cabinet/table and stand are included despite the 'ONLY HEAD' claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the head removed from the cabinet, or seller confirmation with a photo of exactly what ships.
risks.if_unproven: priced as head only, no cabinet or stand

risks.risk: Incomplete accessories list due to cut-off text — bobbins, extra needles, belt, or case may or may not be included.
risks.proof: Full seller text or a photo laying out all included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare head with no accessories

risks.risk: Internal rust, broken gears, or missing parts not visible under the decorative cover plate.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside/internal mechanism with cover removed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only condition, mechanical risk assumed

proof_requests: Video of the machine being hand-cranked/treadled and actually stitching fabric
Clear photo of the head alone, separated from the cabinet, to settle what is actually being sold
Complete seller description (the cut-off 'Comes with...' line) listing all included accessories
Close-up photo of the underside/gear mechanism for rust or damage
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a used Two Lion manual sewing machine head, but functionality, cabinet inclusion, and accessory completeness are all unverified, so it must be priced at the worst-case scenario (head only, unproven working condition) until further proof is given.
